text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"full argumentative paragraphs with repeated reasons and examples","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully an essay expands its ideas with supporting explanation rather than leaving them as fragments."},{"evidence":"mostly complete sentences with only occasional errors","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures the ability to produce readable sentence-level meaning despite some grammatical mistakes."},{"evidence":"clear main claim repeated throughout","quality":"organization","description":"This captures having a discernible central argument that is maintained across the response."},{"evidence":"connected ideas using because, although, if, and overall","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures how well an essay links ideas together into a logical flow."},{"evidence":"mostly understandable word choice such as \"dangerous,\" \"trust,\" and \"breaking the law\"","quality":"vocabulary control","description":"This captures using words and phrases that fit the argument and are generally understandable to the reader."}]}
